items.title: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
items.summary: Opponents have questioned the Budget's lack of detail on welfare reform, with the prime minister not outlining a timetable for any reductions.

items.title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
items.summary: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
items.summary: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: 'Continue your journey': Key moments of leaked Spain train crash audio
items.summary: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.

items.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over letter about Meghan's father
items.summary: The police force faces scrutiny over its handling of a letter containing allegations about Meghan's father.

items.title: Jury shown CCTV of Huntingdon train staff using frying pan in defence
items.summary: A train crew member shows "sheer courage and bravery in seeking to save lives", a court hears.

items.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.summary: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

items.title: Hundreds of GP practices lose online services after collapse of tech firm
items.summary: It will cause huge disruption in some parts of England and Wales, say GP leaders.
